pr_coinbase_body: MiCA CASP licence via the CSSF in Luxembourg, passported to all 27 EU states. Coinbase Prime offers custody, execution, algorithmic trading and financing.
pr_sygnum_body: Swiss bank with a FINMA banking licence. Sygnum Select offers discretionary mandates for corporate treasuries, with active management including rebalancing and hedging.
pr_bitgo_body: Institutional custodian with a MiCA CASP licence via BaFin in Germany. ETP-grade custody with an API for integration into your own systems.
a1: No. Custody and execution sit with the regulated partner you choose. Virtuse never holds client funds, keys or Bitcoin.
q2: How is Bitcoin treated in company accounts and tax?
a2: It depends on your jurisdiction and accounting standard; check with your auditor and tax adviser. Our country tax guides summarise the rules in 13 EU countries. This is general information, not tax or accounting advice.
q3: What does a board workshop cover?
a3: Bitcoin treasury strategy, an allocation and risk framework, a comparison of regulated custody options and templates for shareholder communication.
